Figure |. Overview of Omni-Diffusion. Our model takes multimodal tokens as input, processes them using a unified mask-based discrete diffusion model, and generates output data of the desired modality. By modeling the joint distribution over discrete multimodal tokens, Omni-Diffusion can handle not only bimodal tasks (e.g., automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, visual QA, and text-to-image) but also tasks requiring the integration of more than two modalities, such as speech-to-1mage generation and spoken visual understanding.
